correctness.rationale: With companion M and w=(1,1,1), exact arithmetic gives M^22 ≡ I+N (mod23), N²≡0, Nw=5(1,10,10²), and M^506=I+23C (mod529) with C mod23=N. Since 10 has order22, each branch 22-step derivative is a nonzero unit. Matrix binomial lifting for B=I+23C gives (B^h-I)/23^{v23(h)+1} congruent to unit h/23^{v23(h)} times C modulo23; hence exact pairwise valuations for all t≠s, not just mod23 injectivity. The 22 branches each biject every Z/23^k, and cyclic basis (w,Mw,M²w) has determinant -1, so matrix order equals scalar least period. Independent Python exact matrix and full frequency checks for 23,529,12167 corroborate; infinite lifting proof is essential.
